Class DefaultPathVariables

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.bind.MatchedPathVariables
io.micronaut.web.router.RoutePathVariables
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.DefaultPathVariables
All Implemented Interfaces:
NamedValues, PathVariables
@Internal public final class DefaultPathVariables extends RoutePathVariables
The PathVariables of a route match given to a handler function: its variable values, converted with its conversion service, and the target a DynamicRouteTarget resolved for the route.
